title: Barbershop clients book in Telegram, 24/7
lead: Booking in a chat: service, master, day and time, with taken slots blocked, cancellation and an owner panel.

hero.caption: Bot page with its in-browser version (desktop).
hero.alt: Bot page with its in-browser version (desktop).

problem: A barbershop wants clients to book themselves in a chat: choose a service, a master, a day and a time, get a confirmation, and be reminded a day and two hours before. The owner needs to be told about each booking and to see all of them in a table.
built: A page for the bot and an in-browser version of it: you can go through a whole booking with buttons, from service to confirmation.
Times that are taken or already past cannot be chosen; cancelling a booking frees the slot.
The owner gets a notification and has a bookings panel.
For your salon the bot connects to your own Telegram account: you create the bot key in a couple of minutes, and I guide you step by step.

shots.caption: In-browser version on a phone: a finished booking.
shots.alt: In-browser version on a phone: a finished booking.

steps: The client picks a service, a master, a day and a time with buttons.
The bot confirms the booking in the chat.
Reminders go out a day and two hours before the visit.
Cancelling frees the slot; the owner is notified and sees the booking in a table.
stack: In-browser version of the bot (HTML, CSS, JavaScript)
offer: A booking bot for your salon, studio or solo master: services, masters, working hours.
Reminders, cancellation and an owner notification.
A bookings table for the owner.
Setup on your Telegram bot token.
not_included: Connection to any CRM without looking at it first.
